stories.title: Romanian solar and storage: What gets financed and built?
stories.description: Romania’s growing solar and storage market offers significant investment opportunities, but ready-to-build status alone does not guarantee bankability. Investors must assess grid connection conditions, outstanding development obligations and revenue assumptions to determine which projects can secure financing and enter operation.

stories.title: Integrating agrivoltaics with batteries for rural energy and food security in West Africa
stories.description: Agrivoltaics offers a sustainable solution to competing land-use demands by integrating solar energy generation and agriculture, enhancing food security, water efficiency and rural livelihoods.

stories.title: Show HN: Fleetlayer – Framework for running many AI agents on multiple machines
stories.description: Hi HN! I ran into many problems when I started running lots of Claude Code sessions in parallel.

stories.title: Backblaze explains why it's sharing customer information with advertisers
stories.description: Backblaze tells Ars it won't share users' backup, storage files with advertisers.

stories.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?
stories.description: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.

stories.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years
stories.description: Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.

stories.title: Argentina's bid to stop Falklands oil drilling rejected
stories.description: A joint venture between UK-Israeli companies is set to start exploring for oil and gas, but Argentina sought to block it as part of its claim to sovereignty.

stories.title: Christmas market 'absolutely vital' for businesses
stories.description: The Truro market began on 21 November.

stories.title: Scientists turn one of the world’s hardest-to-recycle plastics into high-performance lubricating oil
stories.description: Virginia Tech scientists have discovered how to transform one of the world's hardest-to-recycle plastics into a valuable ingredient for high-performance engine oil. Their innovative process converts discarded PVC into a useful lubricant material in just three hours.

stories.title: Scientists identify two ages when children may be most vulnerable to screen time
stories.description: Scientists have identified two potentially critical periods when screen time may be especially detrimental to children's learning and memory: infancy and the start of formal schooling. Greater screen exposure during these developmental windows was linked to poorer academic performance and weaker working memory years later.

stories.title: Chinese inverter maker bundles DC-coupled storage for commercial sites
stories.description: GoodWe now links up to four liquid-cooled 261 kWh battery cabinets to a hybrid inverter and static transfer switch in a DC-coupled system that gives commercial and industrial (C&I) sites just over 1 MWh of storage.

stories.title: OpenAI counter-sues Apple over alleged theft of trade secrets
stories.description: The ChatGPT-maker alleges that tech giant Apple stole trade secrets through a former employee.
